_README: Two corrections. Naming the bare German articles inside an English definition
makes corpus:validate read the whole field as German — correctly, by its own
rule. The sense is carried by "masculine/feminine article" instead.

expect.def: Of the male sex — the box you tick on a form, and the grammatical gender of der words.

rows.def: Of the male sex — the box you tick on a form, and the grammatical gender that takes a masculine article.

expect.def: Of the female sex — the box you tick on a form, and the grammatical gender of die words.

rows.def: Of the female sex — the box you tick on a form, and the grammatical gender that takes a feminine article.
